title: Kelekdrix, Herald of Trushar
summary: Clear Kelekdrix’s watchers and ushers to break her rocky protection, then maintain control as reinforcements return.
overview: Clear Kelekdrix’s watchers and ushers to break her rocky protection, then maintain control as reinforcements return.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Soon after engagement, Kelekdrix becomes protected and calls four minions. Defeat every watcher and usher to make her attackable.
Reinforcements return on a variable timer. Pick them up and clear them while keeping the raid ready for the boss’s exposed windows.
When active, Kelekdrix can banish her highest-hate player. Have another tank ready to take over.
Her defeat unlocks the lower reaches of Inktu’ta and advances the expedition.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
